observations.title: Pat a living mob
observations.player_action: Use Shift + right mouse on a living target, unless remapped.
observations.outcome: The mod plays a pat interaction instead of requiring a new item.
conditions: Multiplayer visibility depends on participating client/server support; exact exceptions must match installed 1.3.1.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Choose a custom pat animation
observations.player_action: Use a compatible PatPat animation resource pack.
observations.outcome: The same interaction can use a resource-defined animation.
conditions: A cosmetic pat is not taming, feeding or a gameplay relationship change.
